## Job Post Checklist

- [ ] This PR adds or updates one job post under `src/content/jobs/`.
- [ ] The filename is stable kebab-case and follows `docs/id-guidelines.md`.
- [ ] The post includes either `applyUrl` or `contactEmail`.
- [ ] The post includes a clear expiry date.
- [ ] The submitter is a listed member or organiser.
- [ ] The company identity and application path are clear.
- [ ] `pnpm check` passes.
- [ ] `pnpm build` passes.

## Admin Review

- [ ] Approved for publication on the Agentic Builders Collective website.
